Plowing:
- Flat: \(40/10 = 4\) days.
- Hilly: \(15/(10 \times 0.7) = 15/7\) days.
- Plowing total: \(4 + 15/7 = 43/7\) days.

Mowing:
- Rainy mowing rate: \(7.2\) acres/day.
- Since \(5 \times 7.2 = 36 > 30\), the 30 acres are finished during rainy days:
\[
30/7.2 = 25/6 \text{ days}
\]

Total time:
\[
\frac{43}{7} + \frac{25}{6} = \frac{258+175}{42} = \frac{433}{42}
\]

\boxed{\frac{433}{42}\text{ days}}
